groups.label: Training at s^th Stage
groups.title: (a) Training at s^{th} Stage
groups.description: CCT training core: includes two submodules FMM and KCM to produce compatible features Z_s^o/Z_s^n, and uses balanced distillation BCD and BAD to suppress forgetting and improve compatibility; combine L_new, L_ca, L_er with weights α and 1-α to obtain the total loss.

groups.label: Transfer at s^th Stage
groups.title: (b) Transfer at s^{th} Stage
groups.description: Feature transfer at stage s: F^{s-1} and old gallery features are converted by CCT into a Transferred Feature Set compatible with the new model, forming a new gallery feature set.

groups.label: Testing at s^th Stage
groups.title: (c) Testing at s^{th} Stage
groups.description: Testing at stage s: the new model extracts features for the Query and retrieves identity in the current gallery; example output ID: 182.

groups.label: Re-ID Strategies Comparison
groups.title: Re-ID Strategy Comparison
groups.description: Comparison of three scenarios: Feature Replacing, ReID with Re-indexing, and ReID without Re-indexing. It shows the processing pipelines and compatibility differences between old gallery images and query images under the new model.

groups.label: Data Privacy Scenario
groups.title: Data Privacy
groups.description: Data privacy constrained scenario: old gallery images are protected by a lock and cannot be reused directly; only the existing old gallery features are used with the new model to match query features, reflecting Re-ID under privacy constraints.

nodes.label: Data Stream
nodes.description: Entry of the data stream, pointing to old/new data to participate in the CCT training stage.

nodes.label: Old data
nodes.description: Data samples collected in previous stages, used to maintain cross-stage feature compatibility and avoid forgetting.

nodes.label: New data
nodes.description: Newly added data samples at the current stage, used to learn new identities and distributions.

nodes.label: Old Model
nodes.description: The model from the previous stage, used as the source for knowledge distillation and compatibility reference.

nodes.label: New Model
nodes.description: The new model backbone/feature extractor being trained at the current stage.

nodes.label: Forward Mapping Module (FMM)
nodes.description: Forward mapping module: maps old/new data features into a compatible representation space; internally includes BN+PReLU x4, MLP, and Softmax.

nodes.label: BN + PReLU x4
nodes.description: Four stacks of normalization and activation, for stabilization and non-linear transformation.

nodes.label: MLP
nodes.description: A multilayer perceptron that further projects the mapped features.

nodes.label: Softmax
nodes.description: Normalize the output of FMM to align with the compatible features produced by KCM.

nodes.label: Knowledge Capturing Module (KCM)
nodes.description: Knowledge capturing module: fuses outputs of Old/New Model and mines transferable knowledge via a vector store and subnetwork.

nodes.label: FC
nodes.description: The fully connected layer in KCM for feature transformation and compression.

nodes.label: Subnet
nodes.description: KCM subnetwork that learns a non-linear mapping from old/new model outputs to the compatible space.

nodes.label: k_i vectors
nodes.description: The set of knowledge vectors k_i that characterize the structured knowledge of the old model.

nodes.label: u_i vectors
nodes.description: The set of knowledge vectors u_i that characterize the structured knowledge of the new model.

nodes.label: Σ
nodes.description: Summation operator that aggregates multiple knowledge components.

nodes.label: Multiply
nodes.description: Multiplicative gating/weighting to fuse components from different sources.

nodes.label: Z_s^o
nodes.description: Old-domain compatible features at stage s.

nodes.label: Z_s^n
nodes.description: New-domain compatible features at stage s.

nodes.label: Balanced Compatible Distillation (BCD)
nodes.description: Balanced compatible distillation: models the relationship between Z_s^o/Z_s^n, constrains same/different identity similarities, and yields the compatibility loss L_ca.

nodes.label: M^o
nodes.description: Similarity matrix in the old domain.

nodes.label: M^n
nodes.description: Similarity matrix in the new domain.

nodes.label: Similarity of Same Person
nodes.description: Similarity constraint for samples of the same identity.

nodes.label: Similarity of Different Person
nodes.description: Separation of similarities across different identities.

nodes.label: Balanced Anti-forgetting Distillation (BAD)
nodes.description: Balanced anti-forgetting distillation: aligns output distributions using the old/new classifiers to suppress forgetting of old knowledge, producing L_er.

nodes.label: Old Classifier
nodes.description: The classifier head of the old model, used as the distillation teacher.

nodes.label: New Classifier
nodes.description: The classifier head of the new model, used as the student for distillation learning.

nodes.label: L_ca
nodes.description: Compatibility distillation loss from BCD.

nodes.label: L_er
nodes.description: Anti-forgetting distillation loss from BAD.

nodes.label: L_new
nodes.description: Supervised loss on new data for learning new identities.

nodes.label: α
nodes.description: Loss balancing factor for weighting the compatibility term.

nodes.label: 1-α
nodes.description: Balancing factor for the anti-forgetting term.

nodes.label: Multiply (α·L_ca)
nodes.description: Apply weight α to the compatibility loss.

nodes.label: Multiply ((1-α)·L_er)
nodes.description: Apply weight (1-α) to the anti-forgetting loss.

nodes.label: Sum
nodes.description: Sum and combine the loss terms.

nodes.label: Total Loss
nodes.description: The final optimization objective for training.

nodes.label: F^{s-1}
nodes.description: Feature representation produced at the previous stage.

nodes.label: Old Gallery Feature Set
nodes.description: The feature set of the historical gallery that needs to be transferred to remain compatible.

nodes.label: CCT at s^{th} Stage
nodes.description: Apply CCT at stage s to map previous-stage/old gallery features into representations compatible with the new model.

nodes.label: Transferred Feature Set

nodes.label: New Gallery Feature Set

nodes.description: The current feature space/gallery features at stage s.
